scenario: A hospital compliance officer reviews a security incident log to determine whether a data exposure event constitutes a reportable HIPAA breach. The workflow extracts affected PHI entity types and patient counts from the incident record, assesses the regulatory implications under HIPAA privacy and security rules, and produces a formal breach notification assessment report indicating whether HHS OCR notification is required.
info_flow: medical-entity-extractor parses the incident log and extracts PHI entity types, affected patient count, and exposure context → compliance-officer evaluates the extracted entities against HIPAA breach notification rules to determine reporting obligations → reporting generates the formal breach notification assessment memo.
